acceptanceCriteria: In a Ruby request, every row's RSpec spec path is classified as a test; TestRubySpecPathNonRubyRequestBaseBytes still passes
ruby-reference-index-bounded appears only on changed paths whose constants had referrers cut, covered by a test
body: PR #1137 Codex round 1 kept the shared isTestPath at the base rule for byte stability (NGI-V0-038) and added NGI-V0-040 bounds. Limits: (1) in a Ruby request, feature-marker and reverse-import rows use the shared rule, so spec/**/*_spec.rb among them is not marked as a test; (2) the ruby-reference-index-bounded unknown is a repository-wide count attached to every mapped changed Ruby path, not only to constants whose referrers were cut. Expected: RSpec paths are tests in all rows of a Ruby request without changing non-Ruby receipt bytes; the bounded unknown names only affected constants.
title: Ruby impact: RSpec paths in non-Ruby-reading rows are not classified as tests, and ruby-reference-index-bounded is a repo-wide count on every mapped path (PR #1137 round-1 limits)
